def frontmatter(skill_dir: Path) -> dict:
    text = (skill_dir / "SKILL.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
    assert m, f"{skill_dir.name}: no frontmatter"

def make_skill(root: Path, name: str, fm: dict, body: str = "Body.\n") -> Path:
    d = root / "skills" / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "SKILL.md").write_text(
        "---\n" + yaml.safe_dump(fm, sort_keys=False) + "---\n" + body,

def _prov_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "LICENSE-sp").write_text("MIT sp\n")
    for s in ("a", "b"):
        d = tmp_path / "skills" / s
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
        (d / "LICENSE").write_text("MIT root\n")
    (tmp_path / "skills/a/LICENSE-sp").write_text("MIT sp\n")
    return tmp_path

def test_check_provenance_stdlib_only():

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            mods = [a.name.split(".")[0] for a in node.names]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0 and node.module:
            mods = [node.module.split(".")[0]]
        else:

        for m in mods:
            assert m in sys.stdlib_module_names or m in local or m == "__future__", m
    claude = (REPO / "CLAUDE.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for line in claude.splitlines():
        if "check_provenance.py" in line:
            assert "--with" not in line, line
